fusions.name: Ride-By Snag
fusions.desc: You charge up to 7 tiles at an enemy and snag it in passing, dealing 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Wheeling Sweep
fusions.desc: Wheels the haft around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Tireless Stride
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
